decision: Owner decision D49 (#133): on every place of the route slice after leaving the start place there is at least one person, created only from approved data. This candidate supplies the approved-profile side (three npc_binding profiles, one clothing profile, one canonical regional context, two profile successor versions) and the G4 lower bound; the D-2 place-family thresholds are in game-base people_composition_authoring.json (pin c79852e7). Gameplay authoring, no historical claim; individual origin, language and frequency are not asserted.
reuse_note: Body, routine, activity, item, inventory and visual rows are existing approved m2c-npc rows (imported by the m2c-npc P12 bundle); no new activity rows. Ferryman reuses the boatman mooring-inspection activity, householder and mistress reuse the household-servant work-area activity.

source_refs: book:221162 §565 «Аще бо бы перевозник Кий, то не бы ходил Царюгороду» (перевозчик как занятие в древнерусской традиции; не свидетельство о Двине 1230 г.)
profiles.basis: D-2 pf_ferry_landing group ferryman (min 1); pair role x occupation is listed in the occupation allowed_social_role_ids; both approved in the actor catalog.

source_refs: data/world-catalogs/novgorod/m2c-npc-wave/v1/datasets/npc_schedule_routine_rules.json (D-1 householder and haymaker routines on pf_rural_yard)
profiles.basis: Occupation haymaker (approved, archetype agriculture; floodplain hay meadow and livestock economy of the Lower Dvina). No source found for arable farming on the Lower Dvina about 1230 (only XV-XVI century analogues, e.g. book:373631 §307), so ploughman is not used. Low confidence editorial pairing; the occupation label does not assert the householder's whole economy.

source_refs: book:622242 §519; book:648161 §2639 (D-2 basis of the mistress group: one family per yard)
profiles.basis: cook_baker is the only approved occupation whose allowed_social_role_ids contain nov_role_household_mistress (weaver_cloth_worker and market_stall_seller are usable_with_caution and absent from the approved actor catalog). Household cooking and bread; its g3/g4 place types are urban or estate, so the transfer to a rural yard is analogical, confidence low.

clothing_profile.note: Copy of the approved variants; only the allowed role and occupation lists differ (new pairs).

regional_context.applicability_note: Entries carry only g4_ref (no canonical_g5_ref, no generation_template_ref): applicable to every canonical place of that G4 (owner decision Q3a, PLAN-OK-rt-people). Listed G4: those having a canonical G5 whose primary place family has a D-2 population group.

profile_successors.note: Adds the canonical regional context so the existing D-2 profile_ref resolves on canonical places; everything else is byte-equal to version 2.

g4_overrides.basis: D49: a generated place after Vikhtuy locality is not empty; count 1 or 2 with equal weights (was 0..2 equal weights, one third empty). Profile choice, placement policy and version-2 refs unchanged.
